init_fpga: init an FPGA device by compiling C++ sources and loading an AOCL bitstream file via torch cpp_extension
build_fpga_extension: build a torch C++ extension named fpga_extension from cpp source files using aocl compile and link config
load_aocl_bitstream: load an AOCL bitstream file into an FPGA device and return the extension and device handle
compile_fpga_sources: compile FPGA-related C++ source files from utils, ops, and layers directories with aocl flags
review_init_fpga: review the init_fpga function that initializes an FPGA device using torch cpp_extension and aocl configuration
